marta (PM): Quick cross-team huddle 1 ACME pilot target 2026-04-01. Need to lock minimal launch scope and owners for three gates: runtime KV change, tenant CMK, and staging prewarm. Short replies please.

alex (Eng): I can own runtime changes. Need a concise acceptance checklist from product. Is a temporary canary without CMK acceptable?

sam (Runtime): Canary without CMK OK only if we have a documented fallback that isolates tenant keys + audit events. Note: KV change might add ~5-10ms p95; will bench.

jess (Infra): Two prewarm paths: burstable hosted (faster, quota request ~3 days) or Dedicated pool (provision ~1 week + ticket). Recommend burstable to meet the date.

casey (SRE): If burstable, I'll add alerting: sustained_utilization > 70% for 2h -> conversion runbook. I can own the runbook and escalation.

li (Security): CMK onboarding requires HSM/KMS config and rotation policy review; earliest slot I have is 2026-03-18. If canary runs without CMK, provide data-separation design + encryption-in-transit evidence.

alex (Eng): Draft acceptance checklist: 1) E2E generation on ACME test tenant with prefix cache; 2) simulated KMS failure and fallback validated; 3) staging p95 < 120ms; 4) canary feature flag + rollback path.

marta (PM): Add security sign-off (li) and infra prewarm applied (jess). Action owners and short deadlines: alex 	6 Thu COB: delivery plan + rollback flag; sam 	6 Fri EOD: perf matrix; jess 	6 open quota ticket today; li 	6 design doc for review by Thu noon; casey 	6 runbook + alert. Reply with "ack" on your line to accept.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack 	6 will post perf table to /perf/results

jess (Infra): ack 	6 opening INFRA ticket now

casey (SRE): ack 	6 will include maintenance window block if it overlaps (maintenance 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC).

li (Security): ack 	6 will slot review after design doc posted.

marta (PM): Thanks team 	6 I'll consolidate into a one-page launch checklist after Thu updates. :thumbsup:
